generate_wiki_title_to_wikidata_mapping: run the script to generate a pickle mapping from Wikipedia titles to Wikidata IDs from a SQLite database
generate_wiki_id_to_wikidata_mapping: run the script to generate a pickle mapping from Wikipedia IDs to Wikidata IDs from a SQLite database
query_mapping_table: run the script to query the mapping table in a SQLite precomputed index database
pickle_dump_linktitle_mapping: run the script to dump the Wikipedia title to Wikidata ID mapping as a pickle file
pickle_dump_wikipediaid_mapping: run the script to dump the Wikipedia ID to Wikidata ID mapping as a pickle file
